summary: local dev atproto sync swept the LIVE atmosphere while the web service published to the local dev-env PDS — the two halves of dev pointed at different networks
evidence: services/pipeline/.env.example shipped ATPROTO_PLC_URL=https://plc.directory + blank SYNC_PDS_URL while services/web/.env.example shipped ATPROTO_PLC_URL=http://localhost:2582 + ATPROTO_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true. Worker log, pre-fix sweep: syncRunId 8, reposSeen 46, recordsUpserted 201, reposFailed 3 — 46 real strangers' repos pulled onto a laptop, and zero of the locally published records indexed. Post-fix: syncRunId 9, pds=http://localhost:2583, reposSeen 1, recordsUpserted 6, reposFailed 0.
